title: In situ Nuclear Matrix preparation in Drosophila melanogaster enabling genetic analysis of the nuclear architecture
protocol: Collect 50–100 embryos in water in a small beaker using a brush.
Add bleach to the water to achieve a final concentration of 50% (v/v).
Treat the embryos for 2–3 minutes to remove the chorion.
Observe under a microscope to ensure complete removal of the chorion.
Collect dechorionated embryos in a homemade sieve made by cutting a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Wash the embryos thoroughly with running tap water through the sieve mesh until the smell of bleach is no longer detectable.
Rinse embryos twice with 1× PBS.
Collect embryos in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and keep on ice for 10 min.
Fill the tube up to 80% with fixation buffer:heptane mix (1:1, v/v).
Submerge embryos in 0.6 ml of fixation buffer (1× PBS containing 4% formaldehyde) and add equal volume of heptane (0.6 ml).
Mix by vigorous shaking.
Incubate the tube on a rotating wheel at 100 rpm at 25°C for 20 min.
Let the tube stand on ice for 2 minutes.
Gently aspirate and discard the lower aqueous phase.
Add methanol (pre-chilled at -20°C, volume equal to heptane) to devitellinize embryos.
Shake vigorously.
Allow devitellinized embryos to settle at the bottom of the tube.
Gently aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Wash embryos twice with 1 mL pre-chilled methanol in quick succession.
Allow embryos to settle down completely after each wash.
Discard the supernatant by gentle aspiration.
Use fine tip pipettes during all washing steps to prevent loss of sample.
Only use good quality embryos that settle at the bottom for NuMat preparation.
Transfer 3rd instar larvae of desired phenotype into a glass cavity block with 1× PBS using a brush.
Wash the larvae to remove any adhering food material.
Dissect out the tissue of interest (salivary glands or imaginal discs) using dissecting needles and forceps.
Place the dissected tissues in chambered slides for further processing.
Remove 1× PBS from the chambered slide.
Replace with fixation buffer and incubate at 25°C for 20 min.
Remove the fixation buffer from the chambered slide.
Wash embryos three times with PBT, allowing them to settle each time.
Rehydrate the embryos three times for 20 minutes each with pre-chilled PBT in a rotating platform at 40 rpm and 25°C.
Aliquot few embryos/tissues in a 1.5 mL microfuge tube in 0.5 mL PBT.
Store two such aliquots if both immuno-fluorescence and TEM analysis are required.
Add 1 mL PBT to the embryos/tissues in a 1.5 mL microfuge tube.
Incubate the tube at 25°C for 20 min (stabilization).
Discard supernatant by gentle aspiration.
Add 1 mL EB I (prepare and use on the same day) to the tube/chambered slide.
Incubate on rotating wheel/platform shaker at 40 rpm for 20 min at 25°C (salt extraction I).
Allow embryos/tissues to settle down and discard supernatant by gentle aspiration.
Add fresh 1 mL EB II (prepare and use on the same day) to the tube/chambered slide.
Incubate at 40 rpm for 20 min (salt extraction II).
Wash embryos/tissues three times with PBT by adding buffer and rotating/shaking the tube/chambered slide at 40 rpm (10 min each).
Allow embryos/tissues to settle down.
Discard supernatant.
Add 100 μL of DB containing 2 μL of DNase I (10 mg/mL).
Incubate at 37°C shaker incubator for 50 min at 200 rpm.
Repeat step 15 for washing.
Split embryos/tissues from 1.5 mL microfuge tube to two microfuge tubes.
Proceed for immuno-fluorescence or TEM observations.
Dilute primary antibody according to empirically optimized dilution.
Add diluted primary antibody to untreated control embryos/tissues and in situ NuMat in 0.5 mL PBT.
Seal tubes with parafilm.
Incubate with rotation for 3 h at 25°C.
For tissue, add the primary antibody dilution directly to the chambered slide and incubate.
Optionally, incubate primary antibody for 12–16 h at 4°C.
Repeat step 15 for washing.
Dilute secondary antibody according to empirically optimized dilution.
Add diluted secondary antibody to untreated control embryos/tissues and in situ NuMat in 0.5 mL PBT.
Seal tubes with parafilm.
Incubate with rotation for 3 h at 25°C.
Wrap tubes with aluminum foil to prevent exposure to light during incubation.
Repeat step 15 for washing.
After the last wash with PBT, allow embryos/tissues to settle.
Discard supernatant with gentle aspiration.
Transfer embryos/tissues onto a glass slide by adding a small amount of PBT and pipetting along with the solution.
Use cut tips for pipetting out embryos/tissues from microfuge tubes.
Transfer embryos/tissues onto glass slides.
Discard excess solution from slides with gentle aspiration without losing material.
Add mounting media along with DAPI to the required quantity.
Gently place coverslips on top of embryos/tissues using a needle to prevent air bubbles.
Seal coverslips by applying transparent nail polish on all four sides.
Store slides in boxes or slide books away from direct light.
Scan slides immediately or store for up to 16 h at 4°C before scanning.
Fix untreated control embryos and in situ NuMat carrying embryos/tissues by adding 2% glutaraldehyde in 0.1 M cacodylate buffer.
Incubate samples with rotation for 1 hour at 4°C.
Let the sample settle down under gravity.
Discard supernatant by gentle aspiration.
Wash the sample with 0.1 M cacodylate buffer three times.
Add 0.1 M cacodylate buffer to the samples.
Incubate with rotation for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Let the sample settle down under gravity.
Discard supernatant.
Postfix samples with 1% OsO4 in 0.1 M cacodylate buffer.
Incubate with rotation for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Dehydrate samples with 35% ethanol in 0.1 M cacodylate buffer.
Incubate with rotation for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Allow samples to settle and discard supernatant.
Repeat steps using following concentrations of ethanol: 50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 95%, and 100%.
Repeat the wash in 100% ethanol for one more time.
Mix ethanol and n-butyl alcohol (nBA) in a 2:1 ratio.
Incubate with rotation at 25°C for 10 minutes.
Allow samples to settle and discard supernatant by gentle aspiration.
Mix ethanol and nBA in a 1:2 ratio.
Incubate with rotation at 25°C for 10 minutes.
Allow samples to settle down and discard supernatant by gentle aspiration.
Add 100% n-BA and incubate with rotation at 25°C for 10 minutes.
Allow samples to settle down and discard supernatant.
Mix n-BA and DGD in a 2:1 ratio.
Incubate with rotation at 60°C for 1 hour.
Allow samples to settle down and discard supernatant.
Mix n-BA and DGD in a 1:2 ratio.
Incubate with rotation at 60°C for 1 hour.
Allow samples to settle down and discard supernatant.
Add 100% DGD and incubate with rotation for 1 hour.
Repeat step of cutting the microfuge tubes with a sharp blade and taking out the DGD block containing sample.
Trim the sample and cut sections ranging from 70–90 nm thick using a glass knife on an ultramicrotome at an angle of 10°.
Float the sections on water.
Transfer sections on formvar coated copper grids using a loop and handle.
Allow the transferred sections to dry for 2 h.
Dip the copper grids containing sections in n-BA and incubate for 12–16 h to remove embedding DGD.
Dry the grids after removal of embedding DGD.
Observe and capture images using TEM at 120 V.
